name: forgot-pop-order
why: pop-returns-oldest: nothing checks WHICH item pop() returns.

name: forgot-top
why: top-returns-oldest: top() is never tested after two pushes.

name: forgot-pop-shrinks
why: pop-keeps-size: nothing looks at the size after a pop.

name: forgot-full-stack
why: push-full-drops-silently: the full stack is never pushed onto.

name: forgot-pop-empty
why: pop-empty-returns-zero: nobody pops an empty stack.

name: forgot-top-empty
why: top-empty-returns-zero: nobody calls top() on an empty stack.

name: forgot-zero-capacity
why: zero-capacity-allowed: the constructor check is never tested.

name: asserts-nothing-useful
why: tests that run the code but check only that it does not crash: every bug survives (only the stack-is-fine test can pass).

name: a-test-that-fails-on-good-code
why: a wrong expectation: the tests must pass on the real stack first.
